laws.rule: Under the Gunma Tanigawa-dake accident prevention ordinance, anyone climbing in the Tanigawa-dake danger zone (the rock-climbing routes) between 1 March and 30 November must lodge a climbing notification with the Tanigawa-dake Mountaineering Guidance Centre at least 10 days before, on paper or online through Compass (from 15 April 2025). Ordinary trails are outside the zone; for those, a climbing card to Gunma police is asked for. The governor can close the whole danger zone for a set period each snowmelt season.

laws.rule: Gunma Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (群馬県青少年健全育成条例), art. 30. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 10 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) be out alone in that period without a proper reason. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

festivals.what: Takasaki Daruma-ichi (daruma doll market): held each year on 1 and 2 January along the street from Takasaki Station's west exit. The organisers have confirmed 1 and 2 January 2027 (Friday and Saturday); the 2026 market ran 10 am to 4 pm both days.

Takasaki Dance Festival 2027 (Takasaki City): an all-style dance festival at Gunma Music Center, Takasaki. Contest Stage finals and the open Takasaki Stage are on Sunday 21 February 2027 (doors 12:30 pm; Takasaki Stage from about 1 pm, finals from about 3 pm; times may change). Preliminaries on 30 and 31 January 2027 are closed to the public. The page does not say whether spectators pay.
